Author: Lucas
Name: Frame Perfect
Punchline: Sharper DLSS, perfectly paced frames and lower input lag on NVIDIA cards.
Description:
Makes FFXIV look sharper and feel smoother on NVIDIA RTX cards, with no setup.

- Locks DLSS at a fixed resolution (DLAA to Ultra Performance, or custom): no more blur from the game's dynamic resolution while the camera moves.
- NVIDIA Reflex: lower input lag and a frame cap far more precise than the game's own, picked for your screen automatically (G-Sync, fixed refresh rate, or NVIDIA Smooth Motion frame generation).
- Keeps every frame in step with your screen, so none are dropped (measured: 0 dropped frames at 120 Hz).
- Sharpening, newer DLSS versions straight from NVIDIA, and the right DLSS model.
- Sets the game options it needs for you, and puts yours back with one click.
- Explains the rest in plain words, including how to stop G-Sync brightness flicker in borderless.
